import os
import numbers

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/54675/1_54675_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/54675_0_0c3f7008/1_54675_output.xlsx"

target_name = "Gary Stoddard"
target_month = 4

def matches_excel_countifs_criterion_4(value):
    """Approximate Excel COUNTIFS criterion A:A,"4": match numeric 4 or text 4."""
    if value is None or isinstance(value, bool):
        return False
    if isinstance(value, numbers.Number):
        return value == target_month
    if isinstance(value, str):
        stripped = value.strip()
        if stripped == str(target_month):
            return True
        try:
            return float(stripped) == target_month
        except ValueError:
            return False
    return False

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"] if "Sheet1" in wb.sheetnames else wb.active

total_occurrences = 0
target_lower = target_name.lower()

for row in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    month_value = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value  # Column A
    officer_value = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value  # Column B

    if matches_excel_countifs_criterion_4(month_value) and officer_value is not None:
        total_occurrences += str(officer_value).lower().count(target_lower)

ws["F3"] = int(total_occurrences)

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification
verify_wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
verify_ws = verify_wb["Sheet1"] if "Sheet1" in verify_wb.sheetnames else verify_wb.active
print("F3 =", verify_ws["F3"].value, "type =", type(verify_ws["F3"].value).__name__)
